question: Should OpenClaw standardize `openclaw commands list` and `inspect`, including the proposed plugin descriptor metadata, as its supported operator inventory alongside Gateway `commands.list`?
rationale: Tests and terminal proof establish technical feasibility, but they cannot decide the permanent public namespace, schema guarantees, plugin API commitments, or ownership relationship between overlapping inventories.

options.title: Ratify minimal commands v1
options.body: Approve list and exact inspect with narrowly stable fields, explicit plugin-load failure behavior, and a clear separation from Gateway inventory.

options.title: Adopt broader catalog
options.body: Choose the distinct `openclaw catalog` namespace and explicitly own its additional audit, summary, and operational lenses.

options.title: Defer command aggregation
options.body: Keep existing CLI, Gateway, plugin, and node inventories separate until a stronger shared consumer requirement emerges.

recommendation.title: Ratify minimal commands v1
recommendation.body: Approve list and exact inspect with narrowly stable fields, explicit plugin-load failure behavior, and a clear separation from Gateway inventory.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review and history signals place the central command and plugin compatibility decision closest to this contributor's recent area ownership.
